title: A Letter to the Bank
text:
Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about my bank account. Last week I received a letter that said my account was closed, but I did not close it. I would like you to check the account and send me a written confirmation.

Please reply within ten working days. You can send your answer by email or by post to the address at the top of this letter. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully, Maria Lopez.

questions.text: Why is the writer writing to the bank?
options: To say that her account was closed, although she did not close it
To ask for a bank card

questions.text: How long does the writer ask the bank to take to reply?
What can we infer about the writer's tone in this letter?
options: She is joking with the bank
She is confused and unsure of her name

questions.text: What can we infer about the letter's ending 'Yours faithfully'?
options: The writer knows the name of the person she is writing to
The writer is writing to a friend
The writer is writing a formal letter to an unknown person
The writer is sending a birthday card

vocabulary.definition: a written statement that something is correct or has been done
an arrangement with a bank that lets you keep and use money
to answer a letter, email or question

paragraph_translations: Estimado señor o señora, le escribo sobre mi cuenta bancaria. La semana pasada recibí una carta que decía que mi cuenta estaba cerrada, pero yo no la cerré. Me gustaría que revisen la cuenta y me envíen una confirmación por escrito.

Por favor, responda en un plazo de diez días laborables. Puede enviar su respuesta por correo electrónico o por correo postal a la dirección que aparece en la parte superior de esta carta. Espero su respuesta. Atentamente, Maria Lopez.
